name: How much does a second-story addition typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a second-story addition typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a second-story addition can vary widely, typically ranging from $150,000 to $500,000 or more, depending on factors like size, complexity of design, material choices, and the need for foundation upgrades. Decision factors impacting cost include the quality of finishes desired and whether the existing home requires significant structural modifications. Obtaining detailed bids based on comprehensive plans is essential for accurate budgeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Second-story additions generally cost $150,000 to $500,000+. Factors like size, design complexity, and material choices greatly affect the final price.
